Mina's use is the stronger one, so this is the one to change.

summary: The new script[12] works. It stays implied for chapter 3: Mina describes the sushi-day menu ('no meat, no fish, just pick and eat') and states a soft, conditional wish, but never names her diet. 'no fish' usefully covers the fish-heavy Glass Bead trap. It doesn't pre-empt the level_16 'Mina speaks up' beat, because Maya raises the callback first and Mina only answers, which is clue rule 6 as written. The line also sets up the outcomes well: 'not one dish i had to ask about' pays off in her perfect line ('i pointed at three things... didn't have to ask'), and that matches Marigold Cart's review (three of four pots meat-free, separate ladle), Maya's 'a board she can point at' and the scrapbook text. 'most of tonight's board' can be checked against the reviews and doesn't wrongly filter the answer. Its echo of level_10's 'without asking about any of it' is the sushi_day callback's own wording, not a copied line. The Roxy 'coast edition' suggestion still applies and is the only open item.
